acceptance_criteria.criterion: npm run gui starts the server with no errors
GET http://localhost:3420/ returns the contents of index.html with status 200
GET http://localhost:3420/api/projects returns a JSON array
DELETE http://localhost:3420/api/projects/:slug returns 403 for a non-COMPLETE project
GET http://localhost:3420/api/config returns a JSON config object
PUT http://localhost:3420/api/config with valid JSON body returns updated config
PUT http://localhost:3420/api/config with invalid body returns 400
Starting the server on an in-use port logs a clear error and exits with code 1
--port 4000 CLI arg starts the server on port 4000
--ledger-dir /path/to/ledger CLI arg is respected for all API calls

summary: Created mcp-server/gui/server.ts — standalone Node.js HTTP server using node:http (no frameworks)
CLI args: --port <n> (default 3420), --ledger-dir handled by existing resolveLedgerRoot()
Startup sequence: parse CLI → resolveLedgerRoot() → readConfigFromDisk() → startConfigWatcher() → createServer() → listen()
Router: manual segment matching — GET/DELETE /api/projects[/:slug[/work-packages[/:wpId]]], GET /api/config, PUT /api/config (body parsed inline)
Static server: serves gui/public/ with MIME types, path-traversal guard, index.html fallback for /
CORS headers on all responses: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: http://localhost:{port}
OPTIONS preflight → 200 OK with CORS headers
EADDRINUSE → prints clear message to stderr + process.exit(1)
Error mapping: ApiError codes → 404/403/400/500
Added 'gui': 'tsx gui/server.ts' to package.json scripts
311 tests pass; clean tsc type-check of server.ts

comments.note: gui/server.ts is NOT compiled by the main tsc (tsconfig rootDir: ./src). It is run directly via tsx (npm run gui). If a build-time check is needed, WP-005 should add a separate gui/tsconfig.json.

GET /api/config and PUT /api/config are handled via explicit path checks before the general matchRoute() call. This keeps the configPath dependency clear — configPath is a closure variable in handleRequest() and these routes need it, while the other routes only need ledgerRoot.
No observations on code quality — implementation is clean, single-responsibility functions, idiomatic Node.js HTTP server pattern.
